entry.title: One language state across the ledger, advisor, and exports
entry.summary: Au Jour Le Jour now carries one explicit language choice through the interface, Mamdou responses, annual receipts, and shareable year-review images.

entry.title: Private contractor links with durable email delivery
entry.summary: MyCasaPro now creates narrowly scoped contractor invitations and commits their email delivery to a durable outbox before an SMTP provider is contacted.

entry.title: Explicit storage trust across browser and local editions
entry.summary: Au Jour Le Jour now states where each ledger is stored, which capabilities are available, and how data moves between its browser and local editions.

entry.title: Article intake separates event reports from context
entry.summary: Respometer strengthened article-shape detection so live blogs, opinion pieces, explainers, and thin briefs are not treated as discrete event reports.

entry.title: Receipt-bound distributed inference
entry.summary: ChattyPatty separates provider leasing, execution, metering, receipt commitment, challenge, and settlement so distributed inference remains inspectable after completion.

entry.title: Galidima: Private Intelligence Systems
entry.summary: Armel Tenkiang describes Galidima: local inference, bounded context, evidence verification, and read-only operational integrations.

entry.title: Matchday details and safer participation controls
entry.summary: Liga do Povo replaced the older match detail treatment with an interactive matchday board and made participation controls reflect the actual game state.

entry.title: Recurring game discovery and directory trust
entry.summary: The pickup directory was expanded around recurring community games, clearer participation rules, and more reliable regional discovery.

entry.title: Stable recurring-game links during outages
entry.summary: Recurring game identifiers were made deterministic so a known game keeps the same link when the shared backend is unavailable.

entry.title: Runtime checks distinguish failures from unavailable providers
entry.summary: Au Jour Le Jour hardened Janitor checks so provider outages, quota limits, and missing connections are not reported as application defects unless live access is required.

entry.title: Readable, recoverable household-ledger backups
entry.summary: Au Jour Le Jour added a portable HTML backup that can be read without the application while retaining the original importable data.
